title: An Email to Complain to a Shop
description: Practise the present perfect, the passive and formal phrases, then write a polite email of complaint.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I ordered a jacket two weeks ago, but I ___ it yet.
exercises.explanation: Use the present perfect with "yet" in negative sentences for something that is still not done: I haven't received it yet.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: I ___ (buy) these headphones in your shop on 3 May.
answers: bought
exercises.explanation: Use the past simple with a date in the past. "Buy" is irregular: bought.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I would like to receive a full refund.
exercises.explanation: "I would like + to-infinitive" is a polite, formal way to say what you want.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: When I opened the box, I saw that the screen was break.
answers: When I opened the box, I saw that the screen was broken.
exercises.explanation: To describe a state, use be + past participle: the screen was broken.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: The jacket was the wrong size. ___, the colour was different from the photo.
exercises.explanation: "In addition" adds another point of the same kind, here another problem.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word.
exercises.text: I ___ be grateful if you could reply as soon as possible.
answers: would
should
exercises.explanation: "I would be grateful if you could ..." is a polite, formal way to make a request.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I have phoned your customer service line yesterday, but nobody answered.
answers: I phoned your customer service line yesterday, but nobody answered.
exercises.explanation: With a finished time like "yesterday", use the past simple: I phoned.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word BECAUSE. Begin: "I missed my sister's birthday ..."
exercises.text: The delivery was late. As a result, I missed my sister's birthday.
answers: I missed my sister's birthday because the delivery was late.
Because the delivery was late, I missed my sister's birthday.
exercises.explanation: "As a result" introduces a result; "because" introduces the reason: I missed the birthday because the delivery was late.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I expect ___ a reply within seven days.
exercises.explanation: Some verbs, such as expect, hope and want, are followed by the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: I am writing to express my ___ (disappoint) with your service.
answers: disappointment
exercises.explanation: After "my" we need a noun. Add -ment to some verbs to make nouns: disappoint - disappointment.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My phone has not been replaced.
exercises.explanation: The present perfect passive is has/have + been + past participle.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The new jacket was even worst than the first one.
answers: The new jacket was even worse than the first one.
exercises.explanation: "Bad" has an irregular comparative: bad - worse - the worst. Use "worse" with "than".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: According to your website, customers ___ pay for returns. They are free.
exercises.explanation: "Don't have to" means it is not necessary. "Mustn't" means it is not allowed.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word ALTHOUGH. Begin: "Although ..."
exercises.text: I have phoned three times, but nobody has called me back.
answers: Although I have phoned three times, nobody has called me back.
exercises.explanation: "Although" shows a contrast. Do not use "but" in the same sentence.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word.
exercises.text: When I tried the shoes ___, I saw that one was bigger than the other.
answers: on
exercises.explanation: "Try something on" means to put clothes or shoes on to see if they fit.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: The assistant ___ I spoke to was very rude.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" (or "that") for people: the assistant who I spoke to.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The product stopped working after two days.
After two days the product stopped working.
exercises.explanation: "Stop + -ing" means that an action or activity ends: stopped working.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I have waited for my refund since three weeks.
answers: I have waited for my refund for three weeks.
I have been waiting for my refund for three weeks.
exercises.explanation: Use "for" with a period of time (three weeks) and "since" with a point in time (Monday).

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word WAS. Begin: "The box ..."
exercises.text: Someone damaged the box during delivery.
answers: The box was damaged during delivery.
The box was damaged by someone during delivery.
The box was damaged during delivery by someone.
exercises.explanation: The past simple passive is was/were + past participle. We usually leave out "by someone".

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word ENOUGH. Begin: "The jacket wasn't ..."
exercises.text: The jacket was too small for me.
answers: The jacket wasn't big enough for me.
The jacket wasn't large enough for me.
exercises.explanation: "Too + adjective" can be changed to "not + opposite adjective + enough": too small = not big enough.

task.prompt: Last week you bought a pair of trainers online from a sports shop. When they arrived, there was a problem. Write an email to the shop to complain.
contentPoints: Say what you bought and when.
Say what happened when you tried to contact the shop.
Say what you want the shop to do.
usefulLanguage: I am writing to complain about ...
I would be grateful if you could ...
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a pair of running trainers which I ordered from your website on 12 March. The order number is 48213.

The trainers arrived five days late. Unfortunately, when I opened the box, I saw that they were two different sizes: the left one was a 39 and the right one was a 41. In addition, one of them was dirty.

I phoned your customer service line twice last week, but nobody answered. I have also sent two emails, and I have not received a reply.

I would like you to send me a correct pair as soon as possible. If this is not possible, I would be grateful if you could give me a full refund.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,
Daniel Park
